title: MonitoringEvent
description: PROPOSED. Structured observation emitted by the driver monitor. Contains no images or video. The backend owns risk decisions; the monitor only reports observations.

sequence.description: Monotonic per shift; used for ordering, gap detection and dedup.

kind.description: Initial proposed set; extend via OpenSpec change.

simulated.description: True when produced by a mock/simulator.

value.description: Kind-specific measurement (e.g. duration seconds, speed km/h).
